did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. Two MPOs (Anwar in Uttara, Kabir in Mirpur) each had Napa 500 mg on the market, Anwar's with a 10+2 bonus. Wholesale buyer Rahim Traders searched Napa and bid 15% on one and 18% on the other. A second wholesale account then searched and bid 10%. Kabir looked at his bids and accepted the 15% one. The owner looked at the offers.

checks.text: Buyers see each MPO's product as "Anonymous 1 (Siam's Aqua)" and "Anonymous 2 (Siam's Aqua)": a number and the shop's own name in brackets, never the MPO's name
The bonus shows to buyers: "Take 10, get 2 free"
The MPO sees bidders only as numbers ("Anonymous 3: 15% · 1 boxes", "Anonymous 4: 10% · 1 boxes"); the owner sees the real names ("Rahim Traders (01700000004): 18% · 1 boxes")

notes: Done by hand in the live browser, not by a script.

The first MPO account made by the test set-up had no number, so it showed as "Anonymous ?". Accounts opened through the owner's screen always get a number, so the number was set by hand for this copy.

shots.caption: The owner's list: two MPOs, each shown to buyers as Anonymous N (the shop's name)
The wholesale buyer sees Anonymous N (Siam's Aqua), with the bonus line
The MPO sees bidders without names
